name: Rio do Oeste (Brazil)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white over grey-blue, the white charged with the municipal arms.
history: Rio do Oeste is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the coat of arms is prescribed by Municipal Law No. 178 of 2 September 1969 and shows the main crops — rice, cassava and tobacco; blue stands for the sky and white for peace and friendship under the motto Ordem e Trabalho.

features.role: municipal arms with a shield bearing rice, cassava and tobacco under the motto ORDEM E TRABALHO, over a scroll reading RIO DO OESTE
